# ghost_branch (Resource)

Manages a branch in a Ghost repository. Ghost can't rename branches, so changing `branch` creates a new one and deletes the old one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A branch needs something to start from, so the repository must have at
# least one commit.
resource "ghost_repository" "example" {
  name      = "example"
  auto_init = true
}

# A branch started at the default branch.
resource "ghost_branch" "development" {
  repository = ghost_repository.example.full_name
  branch     = "development"

  # Replacing the repository deletes its branches; this recreates the branch
  # in the same apply. repo_id doesn't change when the repository is renamed.
  lifecycle {
    replace_triggered_by = [ghost_repository.example.repo_id]
  }
}

# A branch started at another branch. source also accepts a tag or a commit
# SHA.
resource "ghost_branch" "release" {
  repository = ghost_repository.example.full_name
  branch     = "release/1.x"
  source     = ghost_branch.development.branch
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `branch` (String) The branch name, without the `refs/heads/` prefix, e.g. `feat/login`. Branch names are case-sensitive. Changing it forces a new branch.
- `repository` (String) The repository's full name, `owner/slug`, e.g. `ghost_repository.example.full_name`. The repository must have at least one commit, e.g. from `auto_init`. Renaming the repository updates this in place; pointing it at a different repository forces a new branch. Replacing the repository deletes its branches, so add `lifecycle { replace_triggered_by = [ghost_repository.example.repo_id] }` to recreate the branch in the same apply.

### Optional

- `source` (String) The branch, tag or commit SHA to start the branch at. Defaults to the repository's default branch. Changing this forces a new branch, unless it was previously unset (e.g. after import). A source taken from another branch's `sha` changes whenever that branch moves, which replaces this branch; use the other branch's name to start from it once.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The repository's full name and the branch name, `owner/slug:branch`.
- `repository_id` (Number) The numeric ID of `repository`.
- `sha` (String) The SHA of the commit the branch points at. It follows pushes to the branch.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Branches are imported by the repository's full name and the branch name,
# "owner/slug:branch". The branch name may contain "/".
terraform import ghost_branch.release my-user/example:release/1.x
```
